references.text: Moses sent spies from the wilderness of Paran, near Kadesh-barnea, to explore the land of Canaan, as this verse refers to.
The spies returned to Kadesh-barnea after exploring the land, which is the place mentioned in this verse.
The people's negative reaction to the spies' report at Kadesh-barnea, which is the consequence of the sending mentioned in this verse.
Moses recounts the event when Israel was sent from Kadesh-barnea to scout out the land, a parallel account to what is referred to here.
Refers to when the Lord sent the Israelites from Kadesh-barnea with orders to take possession of the land, but they were disobedient.
Caleb reminds how Moses sent him from Kadesh-barnea to explore the land, the same event mentioned here.
